meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: codified Civil Law commercial system with Islamic Sharia as a residual source; unitary national jurisdiction without separate sub-state tax regimes
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Oman-India Bilateral Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (BIPPA)
Oman-United Kingdom Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement
Greater Arab Free Trade Area Agreement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Royal Decree No. 30/2016 issuing the Law on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing, as amended; Executive Regulations of the AML/CFT Law; Commercial Companies Law issued by Royal Decree No. 18/2019 and its UBO register rules; Central Bank of Oman AML/CFT Rulebook; Capital Market Authority AML/CFT instructions; National Centre for Financial and Economic Security implementing decisions.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access: beneficial ownership is disclosed to the Omani Commercial Registry and competent AML/CFT authorities but is not publicly accessible; nominee arrangements must nevertheless disclose the ultimate natural-person owner.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of sole shareholder/UBO passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin or national passport authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of corporate shareholder, if the sole shareholder is a legal entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry in the jurisdiction of the corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter / banker's confirmation of the shareholder's sources of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Overseas issuing bank of the shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Arabic or Arabic-transliterated statutory forms and memorandum of association ancillary documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Omani licensed legal translator or Omani notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by Omani notary; no further legalization required for domestic notarized translations

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Pre-incorporation KYC must identify all natural persons who own or control, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of the Single Person Company. The sole shareholder, directors, and UBOs must be screened in real time against the Omani domestic sanctions/terrorist list maintained by the National Centre for Financial and Economic Security, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN list, and other applicable bilateral/regional sanction lists. Politically Exposed Persons trigger mandatory senior-management approval, enhanced due diligence, documented source-of-wealth verification, and enhanced ongoing monitoring. Screening results must be archived in the AML/CFT compliance file before commercial registration is completed.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy / Oman Commercial Registry portal operated by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP) — https://investeasy.gov.om
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory trade name must be entered in Arabic in the commercial registry; foreign-origin names and the English trade name are recorded as Arabic transliteration with an approved Latin-script transliteration for official correspondence, banking, and retail branding. The name must not be ambiguous, misleading, inconsistent with Islamic public order, or falsely imply group affiliation, government sponsorship, or public institution standing. The corporate form must be indicated as a Single Person Company (Limited Liability Company) in Arabic.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Sultan, Sultani, Royal, Diwan, Crown, Majesty, Imam
Ministry, Government, State, Public Authority, Municipality
Army, Police, Security, Defence, National Guard
Central Bank, Bank, Insurance, Financial Services, Brokerage, Securities, Investment Fund
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A reserved name is valid for 30 days and may be renewed once for a further 30-day period through the Invest Easy portal before expiration. If the name is rejected, the applicant may file an administrative appeal through the Invest Easy 'Inquiries and Appeals' function within 15 working days of rejection, attaching a rectified name, justification, and any regulatory clearances required for sensitive tokens. MCIIP must issue a reasoned decision within 20 working days. If the rejection is maintained, a further administrative appeal may be brought before the competent Omani administrative court under the applicable administrative litigation procedure, and the applicant may simultaneously file a fresh name reservation request without prejudice.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the primary registered office for this ISIC 4721 grocery retail scope. A physical retail premises approved by the local municipality, Civil Defense, and public health authorities is mandatory before the commercial registration can be activated. A virtual office may be considered only for ancillary correspondence or administrative mailing address once the physical licensed storefront exists.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: estimated 85-90% probability of an unannounced physical inspection in the first 12 months of operation. Food retail premises are routinely inspected by Muscat Municipality, the Public Authority for Consumer Protection, and Civil Defense, with quarterly and follow-up unannounced visits.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law of the Sultanate of Oman, Royal Decree No. 18/2019, Articles 152-169 (Limited Liability Company provisions applicable to Single Person Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Commercial Registration Directorate, via Invest Easy / Oman Business Platform (e.oman.om)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association executed before a Notary Public in Oman, filed as the Commercial Registration (CR) application through Invest Easy
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No substantive minimum capital is imposed for a foreign-owned Single Person Company; a nominal paid-up share capital of OMR 500 (approx. USD 1,300) is stated in the MOA and fully deposited into a local Omani bank account in the company's name. A bank deposit certificate must accompany the CR filing. No government escrow or blocked-account rule applies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscriber adopts, and agrees to file, the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Single Person Company. RESOLVED that the registered office is established at the premises identified in the leasing contract in [Muscat]. RESOLVED that the nominal share capital of OMR 500 be fully subscribed and paid, and the bank certificate be attached for registration. RESOLVED that [Name] be appointed General Manager and legal representative, with full authority to administer the commercial registration process before MoCIIP, to sign the lease and municipal filings, and to open the company bank account. RESOLVED to pursue all food-retail municipal and civil defense approvals.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP - Trade Name Registration Unit through the Invest Easy portal (e.oman.om)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register and login to the Invest Easy platform, select 'Trade Name Reservation', and submit up to three English and Arabic name alternatives for Asian supermarket retail use. The system screens against reserved names and public-order rules. Once one alternative is approved, the reservation is locked for 60 days and can be extended.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the sole shareholder
Statement of business activity (ISIC 4721 - retail sale of food in specialized stores)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected on similarity grounds, propose a new combination of names; a formal appeal may be filed with the Trade Name Committee of MoCIIP within 15 days from rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office - Ministry of Justice (drafting by a licensed Omani law firm)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a law firm to draft the Arabic-language MOA/AOA in compliance with Royal Decree 18/2019. The sole shareholder executes the documents in person before the notary. If the bank account is already opened in the company name, the capital deposit certificate is appended; otherwise capital may be deposited immediately after notarization.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries require amendments, the law firm corrects and re-notarizes; typical correction is resolved within two working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP - Commercial Registration Directorate (Invest Easy One-Stop-Shop)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized MOA/AOA and attachments through Invest Easy or physically at the MoCIIP One-Stop-Shop. Pay the prescribed OMR 20 registration fee and the electronic CR issuance fee. On approval, an electronic Commercial Registration certificate is issued citing the SPC legal form, capital, and business objective.
required_dossiers: Lease contract or landlord NOC confirming registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an application query arises due to document deficiency, remediate within 15 calendar days through the Invest Easy case file; failure to respond causes automatic withdrawal and a fresh application must be filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Tax Identification Number
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) - online registration portal (taxoman.gov.om)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register online after CR issuance to obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and, where applicable, register for VAT. A VAT certificate is issued upon passing the mandatory OMR 38,500 threshold; voluntary registration is available for food and beverage retail.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of shareholder or General Manager
Registered office address proof in Oman
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the portal rejects the application for missing documents, upload amended scans within 10 days; request follow-up through the OTA call center.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry Membership
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) - Membership Affairs Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an OCCI membership application with the CR certificate and passport copies; pay the annual subscription fee tiered to the capital and activity; the OCCI certificate is necessary for future importer status for Asian food products.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Clarify or resubmit within 10 working days if OCCI requests amendments; escalate to the OCCI secretariat for excessive delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commercial License and Food Safety Inspection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality - Department of Commercial Licensing and Food Safety Section (or relevant Governorate Municipality)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the municipal license application with a dimensioned floor plan, lease contract, and landlord NOC; undergo a food-safety inspection of the retail premises covering cold storage, shelving, hygiene, and pest control. Pay the annual license fee based on floor area (approx. OMR 100-200).
required_dossiers: Notarized lease contract with landlord NOC
Dimensioned floor plan of the retail premises
Food handler health certificates for staff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the inspector lists non-conformities, make corrections and request re-inspection within 7 days; appeals lie to the Municipal Licensing Committee within 15 days of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Civil Defense and Fire Safety Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Civil Defense and Ambulance Authority (CDAA) - Royal Oman Police
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a fire safety certificate for the retail premises, including installation of fire extinguishers, emergency exit signage, and emergency lighting; inspection verifies occupancy load and equipment servicing records.
required_dossiers: Municipal license application or Commercial Registration
Fire equipment purchase and service invoices
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify breaches such as blocked exits or expired extinguishers, obtain maintenance certificates, and schedule a re-inspection within 10-15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banks licensed by the Central Bank of Oman (e.g., Bank Muscat, National Bank of Oman, HSBC Oman)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate current account in the SPC name upon presentation of the CR, MOA, and tax registration; deposit the OMR 500 capital and request a deposit certificate for the CR file; simultaneously activate POS and card acquiring services for the supermarket.
required_dossiers: Tax card or Tax Identification Number
Board resolution and General Manager appointment letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises KYC queries, furnish additional source-of-funds evidence within 30 days; escalate via the Branch Manager for expedited review.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: MoCIIP - Directorate General of Commerce and Municipal Licensing; Muscat Municipality - Commercial Licensing and Food Safety Department
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Commercial Operating License for Foodstuff Retail (Asian Specialized Grocery / ISIC 4721)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority (EA) of the Sultanate of Oman, with waste oversight coordination via Oman Environmental Services Holding Company (be'ah)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from Full EIA - small retail food premises fall under EA Registration Level C; a simple self-assessment environmental registration is required, with no Environmental Impact Assessment Report mandate unless building area exceeds 1,000 m2 or large cold-storage refrigerant capacity thresholds are surpassed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: connection to municipal sewer per Muscat Municipality drainage bylaws with no untreated food-oil discharge; Solid and food waste: segregated storage in sealed receptacles and disposal by licensed be'ah collectors; Refrigerants: non-ozone-depleting gases only, with equipment registration under EA rules; Indoor air and ventilation: compliance with municipal health code; negligible VOC emissions from cleaning agents accepted under code.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: CDAA Fire Safety Certificate for premises occupancy covering maximum occupancy load, emergency exits, extinguishers, and smoke detectors; Muscat Municipality building and structural clearance verifying floor load capacity and safe layout for cold-storage equipment; occupational health cards for food-handling staff issued after municipal health screening.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Secretariat General of Taxation (SGT), Ministry of Finance, Sultanate of Oman; online filing and registration via the Tax Portal at https://tax-portal.gov.om
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon incorporation of the foreign-owned Single Person Company, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) issues a Commercial Registration Number, which serves as the corporate Tax Identification Number (TIN). For VAT, the SPC must apply through the SGT Tax Portal using its CR number and Omani shareholder/manager documents, declare expected taxable supplies over the next 12 months, and provide bank and establishment details. The SGT issues the VAT Registration Number (VRN) and a VAT-related TIN within 20 working days. A foreign entity without a domestic establishment or permanent establishment making taxable supplies in Oman must file the VAT registration application via the Tax Portal, appoint a tax representative/agent under a notarized power of attorney, and submit the foreign incorporation certificate, evidence of supplies in Oman, and banking details.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election is available under Omani law; entity classiﬁcation follows the Commercial Companies Law and is per se taxable. Available elections are limited to voluntary VAT registration, selection of the tax accounting period with prior SGT approval, and treaty-based application for tax residence certificates.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: OMR 38,500 mandatory registration on a rolling 12-month taxable-supply turnover basis; voluntary registration at OMR 19,250
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman currently applies a post-audit VAT model without mandatory real-time fiscal clearance; VAT-registered businesses must issue tax invoices electronically or in paper form showing prescribed data elements, retain electronic/paper records for at least 5 years, and submit VAT returns electronically via the SGT Tax Portal. No government API-based real-time clearance or QR-code digital stamping is mandatory as of the current effective tax period.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for goods physically exported from Oman to a destination outside the GCC VAT implementing states, provided export occurs within 90 days of the supply and sufficient evidence of physical departure is retained. Certain cross-border services supplied to a non-resident directly and consumed wholly outside Oman, plus international transport of goods/persons out of Oman, are also zero-rated. Supplies to GCC countries are generally treated as switched/removal to another GCC territory and may be taxable in the receiving GCC state rather than zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Bank Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT confirmation of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating claims trigger SGT audit re-characterization and retrospective assessment of the erroneously zero-rated VAT, with late-payment penalties of up to 2% per month of delay. Evasion penalties under the VAT Law may reach 100% of the tax evaded with a minimum fine of OMR 1,000, plus possible imprisonment up to 3 years; the SGT may also claw back prior refunds, impose publication of the violation, and disqualify the taxpayer from future export zero-rating.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO), the sole statutory monetary, banking and foreign-exchange regulator established by the Banking Law (Royal Decree 114/2000, as amended); supervises all licensed banks and authorized dealers, administers Oman's IMF Article VIII convertibility obligations, the OMR/USD peg (USD 1 = OMR 0.3845, i.e., OMR 1 = USD 2.6008), and the foreign-exchange and balance-of-payments statistical reporting framework enforced through commercial banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial is fully convertible for current international transactions; Oman has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations. The currency has been pegged to the US dollar at USD 1 = OMR 0.3845 since 1986, which eliminates OMR/USD conversion risk while leaving EUR, GBP, THB, CNY, VND and other Asian cross-currency exposure. Capital-account transactions are liberalized for this SPC: the Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree 50/2019) permits 100% foreign ownership and free profit repatriation. No CBO exchange-control permit is required for equity injection, import payments, or dividend remittances. Practical hurdles are documentary and tax-driven: outbound profit or dividend remittances require an Oman Tax Authority (OTA) tax-clearance certificate and settled corporate income tax (progressive rates under Royal Decree 9/2017, as amended: OMR 30,000 exempt, 12% on the next OMR 970,000, and 15% above OMR 1,000,000); VAT at 5% applies to supermarket retail sales. Banks must sight the underlying commercial invoice, import customs declaration, or tax clearance before executing any cross-border payment. No ceiling or percentage restriction applies to current or capital transfers; bank transfers of any size are lawful subject to AML screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman does not operate any statutory export-proceeds surrender regime: there is no mandated percentage of export receipts that must be converted into OMR and no codified repatriation deadline under the Banking Law, CBO exchange-control rules, or Income Tax Law. Exporters may hold foreign-currency proceeds indefinitely in licensed foreign-currency accounts at CBO-authorized dealers. The binding obligations are (i) all export or trade proceeds must be received through a CBO-licensed bank so the monthly balance-of-payments reporting return captures the transaction; and (ii) banks apply a trade-finance and AML prudential review when export receivables remain outstanding beyond 180 days from the bill of lading date. For the SPC's re-export of imported Asian condiments, proceeds must land in the Omani corporate account and be supported by the export invoice and outbound customs entry; conversion to OMR, if any, is made at the bank's published market spread with zero compulsory ratio.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Contribution / Share Capital Collection Account and OMR/USD Operational Current Account
Operational Current Account with Import Letters of Credit and Trade Finance Facility
Dual-Currency Operational Account (OMR/USD) wired to the HSBC Group intra-bank Asia correspondent network for Thai, Vietnamese and Chinese supplier settlements
Operational Account with FX Forward Booking and Merchant POS Acquiring
Operational Current Account with Revolving Trade Finance and LC Disbursement Sub-Account
Operational Account with SME Digital Banking, Open-Account Import Payments and LC Back-Stop Facility
OMR-only Operational Account with Card Acquiring; limited Asian-corridor FX capability

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as the primary banking rail; Medium as a strictly supplementary small-value supplier payment corridor. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Revolut Business, Airwallex, Currencycloud) hold no CBO banking license, are not authorized dealers, cannot maintain OMR settlement accounts, cannot access the Oman Clearing House or local POS acquiring network, and must not be used to receive trade or export proceeds without triggering an AML red flag and breaching the Omani bank's account terms. The CBO Regulatory Sandbox Framework (2019) and the payments-by-non-bank circulars allow fintech pilots only through a CBO-licensed sponsor bank; a standalone foreign EMI license confers no in-country legal status. If used at all, the EMI must be restricted to minor supplier disbursements with full disclosure to the Omani bank, each EMI credit matched to source documentation, and same-day onward settlement into the CBO-licensed operating account to avoid layering inferences.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is mandatory. CBO-licensed banks require the SPC's sole shareholder-manager, or a formally appointed director with authenticated power of attorney, to attend an in-person KYC/CDD interview at the branch to execute the account mandate and answer source-of-wealth, trade-flow, and beneficial-ownership questions. Fully remote account opening for a foreign-owned single-person company is not accepted under current CBO guidance; video-call KYC is available only to supplement, not replace, the physical interview. All corporate documents (Commercial Registration extract, Articles of Association, FDI certificate, board or shareholder resolution, passport and visa of the UBO, proof of address, and trade licenses) must be legalized or apostilled, translated into Arabic where required, and accompanied by an Omani Civil ID for any resident authorized signatory. A resident manager in Oman is strongly recommended as the operational signatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Single non-resident foreign natural person as 100% ultimate beneficial owner with no verifiable source of wealth and no prior Omani tax presence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CBO-EDD package comprising a notarized and apostilled passport copy; three months of personal bank statements evidencing accumulated wealth; audited financial statements or tax returns of the beneficial owner and any affiliated group; a clear shareholding diagram and Commercial Registration extract; a sworn source-of-funds declaration; a formal business plan with projected profit-and-loss and cash-flow statements; the supermarket's lease agreement and utility bill demonstrating physical operations; and, if applicable, a valid Omani residence visa.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-counterparty profile concentrated in Asian jurisdictions (China, Thailand, Vietnam) where supplier beneficial ownership is opaque and sanctions or PEP screening is ambiguous
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supplier KYC and trade-compliance file containing official business-registration certificates of each foreign supplier; signed purchase contracts and commercial invoices with Incoterms; bills of lading and Omani customs entries for the first two shipments; phytosanitary certificates and certificates of origin for vegetable imports; negative sanctions and PEP screening reports (UN, OFAC, EU, HM Treasury) for every supplier and its beneficial owners; and a written declaration of final consignees to preclude transshipment or dual-use concerns.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-intensive supermarket retail model predicting structured daily cash deposits and potential layering against imported-goods turnover
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: POS merchant-acquiring agreement and daily settlement statements; Z-reads and sales transaction logs exported from the cash register; a written cash-deposit policy covering daily tipping, same-day branch deposit, or cash-in-transit arrangement; month-end stock and sales reconciliation ledger; an accountant's attestation reconciling the cash-to-electronic sales ratio with VAT returns filed at 5%; and a documented shrinkage and refund policy to explain register variances.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of the Commercial Registration License, municipal trade license and Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) membership.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) Commercial Registry — Invest Easy portal; Muscat Municipality; OCCI.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 December of each calendar year; first-year registration is prorated while renewals follow the calendar-year cycle.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A 25% late-renewal surcharge on the license fee plus OMR 10 (≈ USD 26) per month of delay; license suspension after sustained default; failure to renew for more than six months triggers administrative strike-off proceedings and dissolution under the Commercial Companies Law (RD 18/2019).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of the annual audited financial statements (annual return) of the SPC.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registry — Invest Easy portal.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months of the financial year-end (by 30 June for a 31 December year-end).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty up to OMR 500 (≈ USD 1,300) for late deposit; recurrent non-filing suspends the commercial license, blocks all Invest Easy transactions, subjects managers to liability under the Commercial Companies Law, and leads to administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return with audited financial statements and tax-clearance confirmation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), electronic filing portal.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months of the tax year-end (by 30 June for calendar-year taxpayers), with a discretionary OTA extension of up to 60 days on application.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty up to OMR 1,000 (≈ USD 2,600) plus a 10% surcharge on tax assessed and 1% monthly interest on unpaid tax; denial of tax clearance blocks the next license renewal; persistent non-filing leads to enforced assessment, collection action and strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation and update of shareholder, manager and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) data in the Beneficial Ownership Register.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registry — Invest Easy portal; information re-inspection by the Oman Financial Intelligence Unit and AML supervisory bodies.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the annual license renewal by 31 December; occurrence-based updates within 15 days of any UBO, shareholding or manager change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: UBO confirmation is a statutory precondition to annual license renewal; inaccurate, incomplete or omitted UBO records attract AML/CFT penalties and registration suspension, and continuing non-compliance results in administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Sole shareholder's annual written resolution approving the audited financial statements and determining profit appropriation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal statutory record held at the SPC's registered office; available for inspection by MoCIIP and OTA.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the financial year-end (general-assembly timing rule under the Commercial Companies Law).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate filing penalty, but the audited accounts cannot lawfully be deposited without approval; delayed approval exposes managers to liability for premature distributions and incomplete statutory records, compounding strike-off risk in any forced-dissolution review.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No revenue, asset or employee threshold exists: every Omani Single Person Company (SPC) and limited liability company under the Commercial Companies Law (RD 18/2019) must appoint at least one audit firm licensed by MoCIIP and registered with the Oman Tax Authority, and must carry out a statutory audit of its annual financial statements each year.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted for use in Oman; eligible small companies may apply IFRS for SMEs for their MoCIIP and OTA filings unless the articles of association require full IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Oman operates a registry-based UBO confirmation: the sole shareholder, as 100% owner and controlling person of the SPC, declares UBO data on registration and reconfirms it during the annual license renewal on the Invest Easy portal. Any transfer of shares or change in control, manager or UBO must be filed with the Commercial Registry within 15 days and reflected in the company's internal Beneficial Ownership Register kept at the registered office.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,300 – 1,800 per year (≈ OMR 500 – 700) for a Muscat-registered corporate-services agent providing the registered office, annual filing support and license renewal administration.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,000 – 3,000 per year (≈ OMR 385 – 1,155) charged by a licensed audit firm for an imported-goods grocery retail SPC, depending on transaction volumes, inventory valuation complexity and branch presence.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% for companies resident in Oman under Oman Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 28/2009, as amended)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: A zero-rate bracket applies to taxable income up to OMR 100,000 for qualifying small and medium enterprises registered under Omani SME criteria; a five-year tax holiday may be granted by the Oman Investment Authority for strategic foreign-direct-investment projects but is not automatically available to a conventional supermarket SPC

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1 – Corporate Income Tax Return (Income Tax Law Executive Regulation) filed through the Oman Tax Authority e-Services Portal: https://tax.oman.om
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (no quarterly return; tax is levied on the accounting period declared in the audited financial statements; quarterly instalment payments may be required on assessment)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months after the fiscal year-end, i.e., by 30 April for a 31 December year-end, unless an extension is granted in writing by the Oman Tax Authority

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: legal name of the Single Person Company, Commercial Registration number, Tax Identification Number, fiscal year start and end dates, accounting basis (cash or accrual), address and branch locations
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Oman SPC's registration details only; do not insert the non-resident parent as the taxpayer. The non-resident beneficial owner should be separately disclosed in the related-party and UBO declaration schedules

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue / gross receipts from the supermarket grocery business: all sales of imported Asian condiments, fresh and packaged vegetables, essentials, foodstuff and ancillary retail revenue, after returns and discounts, excluding VAT collected as an agent of the State if registered for VAT
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report revenue on the basis of the audited financial statements of the Omani SPC. Import purchases from a related foreign distributor must be recorded at the arm's length price and cross-referenced to the transfer pricing schedule

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales: opening inventory plus purchases from vendors and affiliates (including freight, insurance and customs duties) less closing inventory
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For cross-border purchases from a related supplier, cost of sales must reflect the transfer pricing method applied (e.g., resale price method or CUP); a basis for adjustment must be maintained in the Local File

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross profit: gross revenue less cost of sales
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No non-resident entry is required on this line; any gross profit margin distortion must be explained in the TP reconciliation notes

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses: staff salaries and social insurance, rent of store premises, utilities, marketing and advertising, depreciation, repairs, licenses, local transport and administrative overheads actually incurred in generating Omani taxable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Charges recharged by the non-resident parent (e.g., management fees, group support, brand fees, and IT costs) are deductible only if they are supported by valid invoices, reflect an arm's length charge, and are included in the transfer pricing documentation. Generic head-office allocations without actual services are denied

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-deductible add-backs: tax penalties, personal drawings, general provisions not yet realised, donations to non-approved entities, bribes, non-business entertainment, and interest on excessive related-party debt above the arm's length ceiling
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any cross-border interest, royalty or service fee paid directly or indirectly to a non-resident related party that fails the economic substance or arm's length test must be added back to taxable income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income before loss relief: gross profit less deductible expenses plus non-deductible add-backs and capital gains adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is the Omani statutory taxable income of the SPC. A non-resident shareholder cannot offset its own expenses or losses against the SPC's income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses brought forward: losses incurred in prior tax years and available for use within the five-year carryforward window, subject to continuity of ownership and business rules
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses are available exclusively to the Omani tax resident entity. Transfer of losses to a non-resident shareholder or non-resident group company is not permitted

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after loss set-off: net taxable income less eligible losses brought forward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If no taxable income remains after loss relief, enter zero; the non-resident parent cannot consolidate income or losses for Oman CIT purposes through this box

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax on taxable income at the statutory headline rate: 15%; where the SME preferential bracket applies, apply the zero percent rate on the first OMR 100,000 of eligible small-entity taxable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The rate is applied at the level of the Oman SPC. A non-resident shareholder has no direct Oman CIT liability in respect of the SPC's trading profits

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits: credits for taxes withheld in another jurisdiction on income also taxable in Oman, as permitted by a tax treaty or Oman Income Tax Law
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only the Oman SPC may claim foreign tax credits. The non-resident parent cannot use credits attributable to the SPC against its own home-country tax liability

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transaction schedule / transfer pricing disclosure: listing of all controlled transactions with non-resident affiliates, including goods purchases, services, intangibles, interest, and the selected arm's length method
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose every transaction with the non-resident parent, sister entities, or a beneficial owner's other companies, including the local currency amounts, the method chosen, and the TP documentation docket number maintained for inspection

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance payment adjustments, withholding-tax credits, estimated assessments and tax prepayments for the year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report any Omani WHT credits, customs-duties credits, or advance payments attributable to the SPC; do not include credits arising in the non-resident shareholder's own tax jurisdiction

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total tax payable / refund due: box 8a tax amount less box 8b credits less box 10 prepayments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The same return line remains the SPC's final amount due. Payment must be made in OMR from the SPC's Omani bank account

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration and signature: name, position (e.g., sole manager, director, accounting officer), date, authority to sign, and declaration that the return is true, complete and correct
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The legal representative of the Oman SPC, ordinarily the registered Omani manager or a licensed accountant holder of the power of attorney, must sign. A non-resident director cannot sign unless validly appointed under the SPC constitutional documents; false declarations trigger director liability

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fixed administrative fine of OMR 500 to OMR 5,000 plus a 1% per month surcharge on the unpaid tax for each month of delay; late payment accrues interest at 1% per month on the outstanding liability. A grossly underdeclared return exposing tax evasion may attract a penalty up to 100% of the underpaid tax, prosecution, and imprisonment under Royal Decree 28/2009 as amended

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends distributed by an Omani single person company to its corporate shareholder; Oman does not impose a statutory dividend withholding tax on profit distributions made by a resident SPC out of taxed profits
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Although no Oman dividend WHT arises, treaty relief for any reduced source taxation of royalties, interest or services is obtained administratively by: (i) filing an online DTA-relief request through the Oman Tax Authority e-Services portal; (ii) submitting the letter of request, the yearly audited financial statements of the SPC, a valid Tax Residency Certificate from the non-resident recipient's country of residence endorsed for the relevant tax year, a beneficial ownership declaration, and supporting ownership-chain evidence; (iii) obtaining an approval letter that authorises payment at the treaty rate or a refund of any excess WHT if tax has already been withheld; and (iv) retaining a copy of the submission with the transfer pricing file for the six-year record-keeping period
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 10% statutory withholding under Oman Income Tax Law; DTAs commonly reduce the royalty rate to 8%–10%. Interest: 10% statutory withholding on interest paid to a non-resident lender except for interest on approved bank financing or credit facilities extended by licensed financial institutions, which is generally exempt from WHT; treaty interest rates typically reduce to 0%–10% depending on the treaty and arm's length character

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: OMR 1,000,000 annual value of related-party transactions for Local File; OMR 10,000,000 group consolidated turnover for Master File; a TP disclosure in the annual tax return is required whenever controlled transactions occur
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman does not apply UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations as a standalone code, but the Oman Tax Authority applies an economic-substance and beneficial-ownership test in deriving treaty relief and in scrutinising transactions involving non-resident related parties. A supermarket SPC that is a mere letterbox, has no local management or purchasing decisions, carries no inventory in Oman, or books all profit to a non-resident related party without substantive commercial activity will have intercompany transactions disregarded, adjusted at the source, or denied treaty benefits

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately understating supermarket turnover by suppressing cash sales at the point-of-sale terminals, destroying purchase invoices, overstating purchases from related parties, or fabricating expenses to reduce the SPC's corporate tax liability
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Additional tax equal to up to 100% of the under-declared liability, administrative fines of OMR 5,000 to OMR 100,000, loss of the right to offset losses, criminal prosecution under Royal Decree 28/2009 and the Omani Penal Code, and a ban on receiving future government or free-zone licences
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director or sole manager who signs a knowingly false return is personally liable to the Oman Tax Authority for the additional tax and fines; piercing the corporate veil allows the Tax Authority to recover from personal assets, impose a travel ban, and obtain imprisonment of the responsible officers

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Withhold / Pay WHT on Cross-Border Payments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying royalties, management fees, technical service fees or taxable interest to a non-resident affiliate without applying the statutory 10% withholding, without treaty relief approval, and without filing the required withholding declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Oman SPC is personally liable to the Tax Authority for the gross amount of unpaid WHT, plus the 1% monthly surcharge until settled, plus an administrative penalty of up to 100% of the withheld amount; the withholding obligation is not extinguished by the beneficiary's residence in a treaty country until the DTA certificate is approved
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The local director and the company secretary are jointly and severally liable for the un-withheld tax if they caused the payment instruction to be issued without the WHT approval; civil restitution, attachment of personal bank accounts, and the freezing of exit rights from Oman may be imposed

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Conduit Without Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Oman SPC as a booking-jersey for invoices, routing import documents through Oman without a physical store, staff, inventory, purchase decisions, cash registers or bank accounts, and claiming treaty benefits as a mere conduit for the non-resident parent or a third-country ultimate owner
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Tax Authority is empowered to disregard the interposed SPC, reattribute income to the beneficial owner, deny the entitlement to the 0% dividend WHT and treaty exemptions, impose a 15% CIT reassessment on the reattributed profit, and apply administrative penalties of up to OMR 100,000 for the filing of inaccurate declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil will be pierced when the SPC transacts with no real independent management; courts may declare the SPC a sham and hold the non-resident owner and local nominee director jointly liable for unpaid corporate tax, civil damages, and criminal fraud penalties, including imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the identity of the true shareholder or ultimate beneficial owner behind the ASIAN SUPERMARKET GROCERY HUB SPC, processing undocumented high-volume cash payments through the supermarket POS system, accepting cash beyond statutory threshold for unidentified counterparties, or structuring transfers to evade UBO registration under the Oman Commercial Register
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Sanctions under the Oman Anti-Money Laundering and Combating of Financing Terrorism Law (Royal Decree 30/2016 and amendments): monetary fines of OMR 10,000 to OMR 1,000,000, temporary or permanent revocation of the SPC's commercial registration and supermarket permits, asset seizure, and referral for criminal prosecution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director, manager or shadow owner who knowingly facilitates the UBO concealment or cash layering is subject to criminal liability, personal financial restitution, a travel ban, disqualification from managerial office, and imprisonment up to the statutory maximum for AML fraud; the limited liability shield is lifted where the company is proven to be an instrument of crime

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation Failure / Aggressive Intercompany Pricing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Importing Asian condiments and vegetables from a non-resident related supplier at an inflated price to strip profit from Oman, failing to prepare or produce the Local File/Master File when the OMR threshold is exceeded, or failing to select a reliable arm's length method and maintain contemporaneous evidence
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Oman Tax Authority may make a primary transfer pricing adjustment increasing taxable income to the arm's length gross margin, impose a secondary adjustment on the deemed dividend or loan to the shareholder, levy a 15% additional tax on the adjusted income, and add a penalty equal to up to 100% of the tax under-assessed for the missing TP documentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director who signs the return and the preparer who refuses to file TP documentation are personally liable for fines and assessment increases; where the inflated purchase price was knowingly used to strip profits to a foreign related party, the court may revisit the corporate personality and require the director plus the beneficial owner to make good the tax difference from personal assets
